# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and memory efficiency**

## Highlights

This unreleased update improves rendering responsiveness, memory use, and WebGPU distribution across supported platforms. It synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh, reduces allocations in image and text-shaping paths, packages the WebGPU implementation into the native library, and corrects front-buffered stream retention.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering synchronized** — Coordinates texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother Android output. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily** — Corrects stream retention so buffered input can be released when it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image and shaping allocations reduced** — Optimizes managed image pixel copies and avoids unnecessary native allocations when decoding HarfBuzz feature strings. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **WebGPU implementation packaged with the native library** — Ships the WebGPU implementation in libSkiaSharp.a so native consumers receive the required rendering support with the library. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
